content: BR-locale spreadsheet quirks: Excel picks CSV delimiter from Windows regional settings; pt-BR locale uses comma as decimal separator, so Excel exports semicolon-delimited CSVs to avoid ambiguity with decimal commas inside numeric cells. A parser hardcoded to split on comma will silently misparse pt-BR Excel exports. Separately, Excel's 'CSV UTF-8' save option prepends a UTF-8 BOM (3 bytes); parsers not configured to strip it (utf-8-sig / bom-aware csv option) can end up with the BOM character prepended to the first header/column name, breaking column-mapping logic.
